verdict.rationale: Gitea ships a documented CLI ('tea'), REST API/webhooks, and Actions (YAML-based CI/CD compatible with GitHub Actions), and can be deployed headlessly via Docker/binary on Linux/Kubernetes with no complex config, as confirmed both by docs and community reports of Docker/VPS/Drone-based automated setups. missing for 10: no explicit first-party example of running Gitea itself inside a CI pipeline (e.g., ephemeral test instances) and no OpenAPI spec surfaced for tooling.
